6. Algorithm-Specific Interpretation

  • On the held-out test split (n=3947), the model achieves R²=0.0795 and RMSE=87.35 Wh (compared to Train R²=0.1459, Train RMSE=97.22 Wh).
  • Largest standardized predictor effects in absolute magnitude: RH_1 (+29.83), RH_8 (-22.25), T3 (+22.02).
  • Training-only TimeSeriesSplit(5) selected alpha=1.883 (CV RMSE=97.36 Wh, CV R²=0.0851), converging in 86 coordinate-descent iterations.
  • Lasso retained 15 of 27 predictors and set 12 exactly to zero (44.4% sparsity), shrinking the L1 norm from 403.8 (OLS) to 136.4 (ratio=0.3378).
  • Examples of eliminated predictors: T2, RH_4, RH_5, RH_6, T7 (max |corr| with a retained predictor among eliminated features = 0.971).

7. Limitations and Potential Assumption Violations

  • Feature-selection instability across CV folds: 15 feature(s) were selected in some folds but zeroed in others (e.g., T5 (0.80), T6 (0.80), RH_9 (0.80), T4 (0.60)), a known consequence of L1 regularization under correlated predictors.
  • Purely linear static features without explicit lag or seasonal terms may miss temporal dynamics across the chronological train-to-test shift.
  • Linear models assume additive linear relationships between standardized predictors and the conditional target mean; nonlinear interactions require basis expansion or nonlinear models.
